newsitem.title: USA: Americo Life unit to buy Ohio State Life.
newsitem.headline: Americo Life unit to buy Ohio State Life.

text.p: Americo Life Inc said Friday, its unit, Great Southern Life Insurance Co, has entered into an agreement with Farmers Group Inc, the parent of The Ohio State Life Insurance Co and Investors Guaranty Life Insurance Co to acquire the stock of both Ohio State Life and Investors Guaranty Life.
The two companies have a combined 231,000 policies in force and combined assets of about $900 million.
The total purchase price for the transaction will be about $300 million in cash.

The transaction will be financed through the use of internal funds to the extent of the net assets acquired, with the remainder provided by proceeds from a reinsurance arrangement with a unafilliated reinsurer.
After the acquistion, Americo Life will have about one million policies in force and about $3.3 billion of of assets under new management.
